taxonomy.purpose: Observe the common crypto market factors through BTC, ETH and SOL.
Observe exchange-linked ecosystem activity and token utility; do not equate token ownership with exchange equity.
Observe base-layer execution demand and network economics.
Observe execution scaling, rollup infrastructure and related token economics; distinguish rollups, sidechains and their different settlement/security models.
Observe privacy demand and its distinct regulatory exposure.
Observe Bitcoin ecosystem activity beyond the BTC market factor.
Observe established proof-of-work network and mining economics beyond Bitcoin.
Observe payment and settlement usage; stablecoin issuers and tokens are not interchangeable.
Observe tokenized real-world-asset adoption and the token value-capture mechanism.
Observe decentralized spot exchange activity and liquidity provision.
Observe onchain credit demand, collateral and lending economics.
Observe stablecoin collateral and yield-market economics; distinguish holder income from fees.
Observe staking and restaking demand, security services and holder value capture.
Observe decentralized derivatives trading demand and venue economics.
Observe token launch, auction and capital-distribution services; distinguish protocol economics from the launched assets.
Observe oracle/data-service demand and its token linkage.
Observe cross-chain messaging, interoperability and bridge security demand.
Observe wallet, naming, identity, developer and security services with a documented token-service linkage.
Observe AI network usage and identity services, with a documented token linkage.
Observe application-layer AI services, agents and information-service adoption; marketing labels alone do not establish usage or holder income.
Observe distributed compute, storage and data supply with measurable service demand.
Observe speculative risk-appetite transmission; this is a sensor role, not a quality claim.
Observe gaming and virtual-world application demand and token use; exchange tags do not prove user activity or holder income.
Observe creator, social and digital-collectible market services; distinguish applications from general execution networks.
Observe modular data publication and availability, separate from execution.
Observe custodial gold tokens separately from RWA protocol governance.
